note: Scene-light knobs (book/scripts/modules/scene-light.mjs; canon .spw/surfaces/knobs.spw). Knobs are the few continuous controls that steer the chapter's CSS tokens. Motifs are named presets the active section steers toward; edges (a scene's frame details) deepen the vignette. A reader can take the light and turn any knob; letting go returns the scene's own light.

glow.label: Glow
glow.reads: how strongly the light falls on the page

warmth.label: Warmth
warmth.reads: how much amber is in it

ink.label: Ink
ink.reads: the hue the accents lean toward

edge.label: Edge
edge.reads: how far the dark comes in from the frame's edges
